acceptanceCriteria: Cargo workspace package version、Cargo.lock 与当前三语发布/版本文档一致为 0.2.102，既有历史版本记录保持不变。
v0.2.102 使用未占用的不可变 annotated tag，并绑定经审查合并后的 main 源提交。
公开 provider Release、manifest、checksums、SBOM、archive、attestation 与 source identity 相互绑定。
从公开不可变 Release 下载的 x86_64 产物通过 checksum、隔离 fresh-install、v0.2.100 到 v0.2.102 升级与精确临时目录清理；不写入对象仓库。
发布 Outcome 以中文完整说明完成内容、验证范围、剩余未知和下一步；性能收益保持未知，第三方宿主展示确认保持未知。
实际 GitHub provider、PR、分支与 worktree 资源上下文在 archive 前通过 finalize-plan 绑定，并在合并后执行精确清理、finalize-verify 和 close。
goal: 发布不可变公开 Runtime v0.2.102，并完成公开产物、安装升级、资源清理和发布证据验收；最后才通知 Sentinel 的 Issue #902。
intent: 在全部现有工作、精确资源清理和发布前核验完成后，发布包含 WI-902 verification snapshot lifecycle 修复及本轮收敛成果的新 Runtime。
outOfScope: 不修改 Sentinel 或任何对象仓库；不处理历史 finalization 迁移；不实现新的 Outcome 宿主 API；不把性能噪声范围内的结果表述为提速。

scenarioCoverage.expected: The immutable v0.2.102 tag, stable public GitHub Release, source identity, manifest, checksums, SBOM, archives, and attestation bind to the reviewed merge commit.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: After reviewed merge, execute the existing release workflow and validate every published identity and supply-chain asset against the tag.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The downloaded x86_64 v0.2.102 artifact passes checksum, isolated fresh install, v0.2.100-to-v0.2.102 upgrade, and exact temporary-root cleanup without object-repository writes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use the public immutable Release asset with isolated TMPDIR and CARGO_HOME, then collect checksum, install, upgrade, and cleanup receipts.

scenarioCoverage.expected: English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese release and reference projections retain consistent current version facts.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the deterministic documentation and reference-parity checks before merge and after release closure.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The Sentinel Issue #902 notification is sent only after public release acceptance and Runtime closure are complete.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect the terminal release records and public Release before posting the final GitHub Issue comment.
